slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the profit figures of $5, $10, $8, and $7 per toy the only factors to consider in the objective, or are there other costs or revenues that should be included in the optimization?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly raised the objective and confirmed it is profit-based, but never asked whether profit should be maximized (vs. minimized), so the core maximization direction was not fully clarified.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any linkage between the number of boats and trains; it only asked about minimum production requirements, resource ceilings, and logical truck/train and boat/airplane rules.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to maximize total profit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent's question only confirmed that profit figures are the sole objective input; the maximization direction itself was never asked of or confirmed by the user, yet the model assumed 'Maximize total profit.'

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent declared READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective slot was only partially addressed (maximization direction never confirmed), leaving an unresolved P0 fact.

summary: The agent asked several reasonable clarifications (integrality, hard ceilings, minimum production, objective factors, fixed coefficients) but never confirmed the maximization direction of the objective and never probed the boat-triangle train relationship, stopping with a P0 objective fact only partially resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
